relations.relation: demarcate functional or parameter-reciting claim language subject to written description scrutiny
locate specification passages disclosing concrete structures, species, or specific methods corresponding to the claimed function or parameter
separate mere functional description, method-of-making-only, or aspirational-result statements from passages tied to a specific structure
relate disclosed structures/species to claimed function or parameter to determine whether an established correlation is shown
locate specification content indicating inventor possession of the claimed genus or parameter as of the effective filing date
delimit the scope and boundaries of the broad functional or parameter-reciting claim language
locate concrete structures, species, or specific methods disclosed in the specification that fall within the claimed genus
flag passages that state function, result, or method-of-making without accompanying structural disclosure
assess whether disclosed species establish a correlation between structure and the claimed function or parameter across the claimed scope
synthesize whether the correlation and disclosed species show the inventor possessed the full claimed genus as of the filing date
isolates claim language reciting a function or a specific parameter value (e.g., dosage) as the unit requiring support
locates concrete structures, species, or exemplars in the specification that correspond to the claimed function or parameter
assesses whether the disclosed structure is shown to correlate with the claimed function rather than being merely asserted
flags recitations of desired results or method-of-making alone that lack an established structure-function link
bounds the claimed genus/species against what the specification demonstrates the inventor possessed as of the filing date

metric.name: Written description — functional and parameter claims need concrete support
metric.text: Broad functional claims and claims reciting specific parameters (e.g., dosages) require disclosure of concrete structures/species or specific methods showing the inventor’s possession as of filing. Mere functional description, method‑of‑making alone, or aspirational results without an established structure‑function correlation are insufficient (e.g., University of Rochester; Ariad).
